articles.title: Indian Air Force chief bats for self-reliance in defence capabilities
articles.summary: Air Chief Marshal A P Singh, IAF Chief, emphasized self-reliance (Atmanirbharta) as a strategic necessity for India. He highlighted its crucial role in developing resilient indigenous defence capabilities. This focus ensures India's armed forces are equipped with advanced, domestically-developed systems, reducing foreign dependency, and strengthening national security preparedness against future challenges, vital for an aspirational global power.

articles.title: Jaishankar stresses ‘Make in India’ focus in expanding defence ties with US
articles.summary: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar stated that India's 'Make in India' initiative will be central to the next phase of defence cooperation with the United States. This reflects India's focus on indigenous manufacturing and self-reliance in its strategic partnerships. The statement underscores the ongoing efforts to strengthen defence ties, with a clear emphasis on boosting India's domestic defence industrial base and capabilities.

articles.title: Japan's role in joint drills boosts Philippine, U.S. deterrence
articles.summary: Japanese forces' full participation in the large-scale military exercise with the Philippines and the United States marks a significant development. This enhanced trilateral cooperation introduces a new strategic dimension, bolstering regional security and stability in the Indo-Pacific. For SSB aspirants, this highlights evolving alliances and collective defence postures among key democratic nations.

articles.title: Jaishankar and Rubio hold key talks on Hormuz security and West Asia stability
articles.summary: India's External Affairs Minister Dr S Jaishankar held significant delegation-level talks with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio. The discussions primarily focused on the escalating West Asia conflict and ensuring secure maritime trade routes. These high-level deliberations underscore the robust strategic partnership between India and the US, crucial for addressing regional instability and safeguarding global economic security amidst complex international challenges.

articles.title: AFCAT 2 notification 2026 released for 379 vacancies at afcat.cdac.in; Check eligibility, selection process, application dates and how to apply
articles.summary: The Indian Air Force has opened applications for AFCAT 2 2026, offering 379 officer vacancies across Flying and Ground Duty branches. Aspiring candidates targeting a prestigious career in the IAF can apply online from May 20 to June 19. This presents a prime opportunity for SSB aspirants to join the nation's premier aerial defence force, serving the country.

articles.title: Show HN: I made a tactical map-based WWII submarine simulator (public beta) | Hacker News
articles.summary: An individual has developed a new map-centered, tactical submarine simulator, expressing that the creation process was enjoyable. This project, potentially stemming from discussions on platforms like HN, introduces a new interactive experience within the simulation gaming community, showcasing personal innovation in software development and digital entertainment.

articles.title: Disforia (2025)

It enjoys widespread popularity among Indonesian anime enthusiasts, highlighting the significant growth and engagement with digital entertainment and cultural content consumption within the nation. This trend underscores evolving media consumption habits among the populace.

articles.title: Feels Like Home (2025)
articles.summary: Samehadaku is highlighted as a leading and frequently updated official website for anime streaming in Indonesia. It provides a comprehensive collection of anime with Indonesian subtitles, updated daily, making it a popular choice for enthusiasts across the nation to access new and classic series easily through a dedicated digital platform.

articles.title: South Korea's Hanwha showcases submarine as Ottawa mulls multibillion-dollar contract
articles.summary: South Korea's advanced ROKS Dosan Ahn Chang-ho submarine showcased its capabilities off British Columbia, aiming to secure Canada's multi-billion-dollar contract. This display by Hanwha Ocean highlights intense international competition in defence procurement. For SSB aspirants, it underscores the strategic significance of modern submarine technology for maritime security, power projection, and a nation's naval influence on the global stage, reflecting both defence capabilities and international economic strategy.

articles.title: Suspected terrorists trapped as encounter breaks out in Rajouri
articles.summary: An encounter broke out in Rajouri district, Jammu and Kashmir, following a major cordon-and-search operation by armed forces after reports of suspected infiltrators. This incident highlights the Indian military's ongoing efforts to counter infiltration and maintain security in the region, a critical aspect of national defence operations for SSB aspirants to observe.
